home.heroSubtitle: Free structured A1–B2 grammar lessons, interactive exercises and spaced-repetition vocabulary practice.
home.intro: DeutschStep is a free online platform for learning German from beginner (A1) to upper-intermediate (B2). Every level combines clear grammar explanations, interactive exercises and vocabulary practice so you can study at your own pace — whether you are starting from zero or refining advanced skills.
home.levelsIntro: German courses follow the CEFR scale. Pick the level that matches your current ability and work through grammar, vocabulary and exercises step by step.
home.levelA1Desc: Absolute beginner: articles, pronouns, present tense and everyday words.
home.levelA2Desc: Elementary: perfect tense, modal verbs and dative prepositions.
home.levelB1Desc: Intermediate: subordinate clauses, connectors and the genitive case.
home.levelB2Desc: Upper-intermediate: passive voice, Konjunktiv II and relative clauses.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to learn German
home.featureGrammarBody: Clear, example-driven explanations of German grammar for every level, from der/die/das to the passive voice.
home.featureVocabBody: Build your German vocabulary with words and example sentences drawn from each lesson.
home.featureExercisesBody: Multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blank, matching and sentence-ordering exercises reinforce every lesson.
home.featureSrsBody: A spaced-repetition system schedules vocabulary reviews at the optimal time so words move into long-term memory.
home.audienceBody: DeutschStep is for self-learners, students and anyone preparing for German exams who wants a structured, free path from A1 to B2.

legal.privacyIntro: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and how cookies and third-party advertising services may be used on DeutschLernen.

privacySections.heading: Information We Collect
paragraphs: When you create an account, we may collect information that you provide directly to us, including your email address, name, and password.

While you use DeutschLernen, we may also collect learning-related information, including lesson progress, XP, streaks, badges, vocabulary review history, and other information related to your use of the service.
This information is stored on our servers and is used to provide, maintain, personalize, and improve the DeutschLernen service.

privacySections.heading: Cookies and Similar Technologies
paragraphs: DeutschLernen uses cookies and similar technologies to provide essential website functionality and, where you give consent, to support analytics and advertising.
We use a cookie consent banner to request your permission before loading non-essential cookies or third-party services.
If you accept the relevant cookies through our consent mechanism, we may use third-party services such as Google AdSense and Google Analytics.

If you decline non-essential cookies, these third-party services will not be loaded through our website, and we will only use strictly necessary technologies required for essential functions, such as maintaining your login session.

privacySections.heading: Google AdSense and Third-Party Advertising
paragraphs: We may use Google AdSense, an advertising service provided by Google LLC, to display advertisements on DeutschLernen.

Google and its advertising partners may use cookies, web beacons, device information, IP address, and similar technologies to serve, measure, and personalize advertisements, subject to applicable laws and the user's consent where required.
Third-party vendors, including Google, may use cookies to serve advertisements based on a user's previous visits to this website or other websites.

Depending on the user's consent and applicable laws, advertisements displayed through Google AdSense may be personalized based on information such as the user's interests, browsing activity, or interactions with advertisements.
Users may manage their advertising preferences through Google's advertising settings and may also control cookies through their browser settings.
For more information about how Google uses information from websites and apps that use its services, please refer to Google's privacy and advertising documentation.

privacySections.heading: Google Analytics
paragraphs: If you provide the appropriate consent, we may use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use DeutschLernen and to improve the website and learning experience.
Google Analytics may collect information such as pages visited, interactions with the website, device information, approximate location, and other usage information.
Google Analytics is only loaded when the applicable consent is provided through our cookie consent mechanism, where consent is required by law.

privacySections.heading: Managing Your Cookie Preferences
paragraphs: You can choose whether to allow non-essential cookies through our cookie consent banner.
You can withdraw or change your consent at any time using the cookie or privacy settings provided on the website. You may also delete or block cookies through your browser settings.
Please note that disabling strictly necessary cookies may prevent certain essential features, such as account login, from functioning correctly.

privacySections.heading: Your Personal Data Rights
paragraphs: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us using the contact details provided on our Contact page.
Where applicable under data protection law, you may also have the right to request restriction of processing, object to certain processing activities, or request a copy of your personal data.

privacySections.heading: Data Security
paragraphs: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect the information we collect against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.
However, no method of transmission or storage over the Internet can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

privacySections.heading: Changes to This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes to our services, technologies, legal requirements, or third-party services.
Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date where appropriate.

privacySections.heading: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your personal information is handled, please contact us using the email address listed in your account settings or on our Contact page.

termsParagraphs: By creating an account on DeutschLernen you agree to use the service for personal, non-commercial language learning purposes only.
You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for all activity that occurs under your account.
Content on this platform (grammar explanations, exercises, vocabulary) is provided for educational purposes and may be updated or corrected at any time without notice.

We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, abuse the service, or attempt to disrupt its operation. We reserve the right to modify these terms; continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
